row.body: A key to the office is tied to a fever list; the room is marked sealed, and the supply line says the crew took the food to the gun counter.
row.title: The room behind the barricade

sidecar.gloss: A sealed office and a moved supply line accompany a fever list.
sidecar.rival_reading: Containment staff could seal an office during a fever event and move food; the record does not identify the fever’s cause.

row.body: the measuring tape and clipboard carry the same black paint. a fresh scrape exposes an older evacuation color beneath.
row.title: missing count beside the measuring tape

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
